notes:
Counterfeit screening is removed. Scan review is now a compact match list: each matched scan shows a thumbnail, name and set with Details and one pencil, the batch adds NM ×1, and adding from Details removes that scan. Opening a card refreshes a missing or stale market price automatically, with the cached figure visible while it checks.

Debug build of the PocketVendorTCG Android app (debug-signed). Sideload for testing.
